Tap any downloaded Surah to play or pause it instantly.
Long-press a Surah to add or remove it from your Favorites list.
Favorited Surahs highlight their number badge in the primary theme color for easy reference.
A play icon with a slash (Play Disabled) shows for non-downloaded Surahs, meaning they must be downloaded first before playback.
Search Box: Type in the search box to quickly filter Surahs by name or number.
Downloaded Filter: Tap the cloud check button (✓) to show only downloaded Surahs. Tap it again to deselect and view all.
Not Downloaded Filter: Tap the crossed-out cloud button to show only Surahs that are not yet downloaded.
Favorites Filter: Tap the heart button next to the search bar to display only your favorited Surahs.
Download Button: Appears next to non-downloaded Surahs. Tap it to start downloading for offline playback.
Ready for listening: The cloud check icon appears next to successfully downloaded Surahs, meaning they are ready for playback without an internet connection.
Cancel Download: During download, a circular progress indicator appears with a cancel (✕) icon to stop downloading at any time.
Download limits: You can download up to 3 Surahs concurrently, with a maximum of 7 pending downloads in the queue (10 downloads in total).
Floating download button: Appears at the bottom above the mini-player when downloads are active. Tap it to monitor progress or cancel some or all of the ongoing downloads with one click.
Export to device downloads: To permanently save audio files to your device\'s Downloads directory, navigate to Settings -> Manage and Save Cached Surahs, and tap the Save button.

Control buttons: Repeat, Sleep Timer (to set auto-stop countdown), and Auto-Play (tap to toggle, long-press to reverse direction) are available in both players (the mini-player at the bottom of the home screen and the full-screen player).
Navigation and Play/Pause: Play/Pause and Skip to next/previous Surah buttons are available in both players for easy control.
Seek buttons: The 30-second fast-forward and 10-second rewind buttons are only available inside the full-screen player.
